Clinical trial title: ‘Microbiota dynamics in a randomized trial of gut decontamination during allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation’
Results: No difference in microbial diversity or GVHD outcomes between treatment and control arm

Clinical trial title: ‘Choosing the best antibiotic to protect friendly gut bacteria during the course of stem cell transplant’
Specific intervention: Piperacillin–tazobactam vs cefepime for febrile neutropenia

Clinical trial title: ‘Treatment of steroid refractory gastrointestinal acute GVHD after allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation with faecal microbiota transfer (HERACLES)’
Specific intervention: Pooled allogeneic faecal microbiota (MaaT013) for the treatment of steroid-refractory gastrointestinal GVHD
No. of patients treated: 24 (HERACLES study)/52 (additional patients from expanded access programme)
Clinical trial design: Prospective or compassionate use, single arm, open label
Primary outcome: Gastrointestinal and overall GVHD response on day 28

Clinical trial title: ‘MaaT013 as salvage therapy in patients with ruxolitinib refractory gastrointestinal acute GVHD (ARES)’
Specific intervention: Pooled allogeneic faecal microbiota (MaaT013) for the treatment of steroid- or ruxolitinib-refractory gastrointestinal GVHD
Primary outcome: Gastrointestinal and overall GVHD response on day 29

Clinical trial title: ‘Randomized double-blind phase II trial of fecal microbiota transplantation versus placebo in allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation and AML’
Specific intervention: FMT in two independent cohorts (patients with AML undergoing intensive chemotherapy and patients undergoing allo-HCT)
Primary outcome: Number of infections until 4 months after the first intervention

Clinical trial title: ‘Donor fecal microbiota transplantation ameliorates intestinal graft-versus-host disease in allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation recipients’
Specific intervention: FMT in patients with steroid-dependent or refractory gastrointestinal GVHD
Primary outcome: Gastrointestinal and overall GVHD response up to 6 months after FMT
Results: Complete clinical response in 10 out of 15 patients

Clinical trial title: ‘Safety and efficacy of fecal microbiota transplantation for patients with grade IV steroid refractory GI-GVHD: interim results from FMT2017002 trial’
Specific intervention: FMT vs no treatment in patients with grade IV steroid-refractory gastrointestinal GVHD
Primary outcome: Event-free survival time and overall survival on day 90 after the diagnosis of steroid-refractory gastrointestinal GVHD
Results: Increased median survival time in FMT group (P = 0.02)

Clinical trial title: ‘FMT for the prevention of acute GVHD in adults undergoing allo-HCT’
Primary outcome: Incidence of grade III–IV GVHD up to 6 months after allo-HCT
